items.quote: For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
items.claim: Abraham gives Abimelech seven ewe lambs as a witness that Abraham dug the well, which supports his claim to it.
items.action: gives seven ewe lambs as a witness
items.mechanism: Accepting the gift of livestock serves as public proof that Abraham dug the well, and so that the well is his.

items.quote: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
items.claim: Abraham sets seven ewe lambs apart, and Abimelech asks what they are for. This leads into the witness about the well.
items.action: asks what the seven ewe lambs set apart are for
